messages.text: Hi, this is Mia from Peak Fitness. What can I do for you?
I'm traveling for work for two months starting next week. Can I stop my membership without canceling it?
Yes, you can freeze it for up to three months. It costs $5 per month instead of your usual $40.
Great, that's much cheaper. Will I lose my locker?
Lockers aren't held during a freeze, so please empty it before you go. You can request a new one when you return.
Understood. Please freeze it starting Monday.
Done! You'll get a confirmation email shortly, and your regular monthly payment will start again automatically after two months.

questions.stem: Why does Mr. Moore contact Peak Fitness?
options: A. To pause his membership while he is away
B. To cancel his membership permanently
C. To ask about a new locker
D. To complain about the monthly price
questions.explanation: He asks, "Can I stop my membership without canceling it?" because he will be traveling for two months.

questions.stem: How much will Mr. Moore most likely pay in total during his trip?
questions.explanation: A freeze costs "$5 per month," and his trip lasts "two months," so he will pay about $10.

questions.stem: What does Mia tell Mr. Moore to do?
options: A. Visit the gym on Monday
B. Remove his things from his locker
C. Reply to a confirmation email
D. Choose a new membership plan
questions.explanation: She says, "Lockers aren't held during a freeze, so please empty it before you go."
